description: This file defines React components and utility functions for handling image fields within a Keystone schema, including a Cell component for rendering images, a type for image values, a validation function, and a controller factory function.

methods.name: validateImage
methods.description: Validates an ImageValue to ensure the uploaded file is an image and meets validity requirements.

methods.name: controller
methods.description: Creates a controller object for managing image field states, serialization, deserialization, validation, and GraphQL selection.
